data.title: 玛露希尔 · 魔物料理的真香现场
data.description: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连。

data.promptProse: Left to right, three panels show Marcille refusing the meal, tasting a spoonful, then offering her bowl for seconds. The same cooking fire lights each expression.
data.animaCaption: Left to right: refusal, a cautious taste, then offering her bowl for seconds.
